ارتشيت (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَيْتُ (irtašaytu) /ir.ta.ʃaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اِرْتَشَيْتَ (irtašayta) /ir.ta.ʃaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اِرْتَشَيْتِ (irtašayti) /ir.ta.ʃaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اُرْتُشِيتُ (urtušītu) /ur.tu.ʃiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
